styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Tango, cafés, bookshops and grand avenues.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Steak, empanadas, wine and long late dinners.

styles.label: Nightlife
styles.blurb: Late bars, milongas and clubs that start after 2am.

stays.why: Quiet, leafy and safe at night. Walk to the cemetery, museums and cafés; good for first-timers.
Best for food and nightlife. Soho and Hollywood have bars, restaurants and boutiques on your doorstep.
Old cobbled streets, tango and the Sunday market. Livelier and cheaper; some streets are quiet at night.
Central for the Obelisk, Plaza de Mayo and the train and bus stations. Busy by day, quieter after dark.

food: Order bife de chorizo (sirloin) or ojo de bife at a parrilla. Portions are big; one steak can feed two light eaters.
Try empanadas, milanesa and provoleta. Lunch is the big meal; many places sell cheap set lunches (menú del día).
Drink local: Malbec and Torrontés wines, plus mate. Ask for agua sin gas if you want still water.
Dinner starts late. Locals sit down around 9–10pm; many restaurants are quiet before 8pm.
Book popular Palermo and Recoleta restaurants a few days ahead. Prices change fast with inflation, so check menus on the day.
more_time: Day trip to Tigre: train from Retiro, then a boat through the delta canals.
Ferry to Colonia del Sacramento, Uruguay, from Puerto Madero. Bring your passport; check times and prices on the day.
Spend a day in La Boca and Puerto Madero, or take a tango class and stay for a milonga.

recommend.why: Three nights covers Palermo, Recoleta, San Telmo and a steak dinner, with time left for a tango night.

month_notes: January: hot, highs near 28°C. Many locals are on holiday; some restaurants close. Pack light clothes.
February: hot and humid, highs near 28°C. Carnival and summer festivals; book ahead.
March: warm and pleasant, highs near 25°C. A good month for walking and parks.
April: mild, highs near 22°C. Comfortable days and cool evenings; bring a light jacket.
May: cooler, highs near 17°C. Fewer rain days; good for museums and cafés.
June: cold, highs near 15°C and lows near 8°C. Pack a warm coat.
July: coldest month, highs near 14°C. Winter holidays bring crowds to museums and theatres.
August: cold but dry-ish, highs near 16°C. Good for indoor sights and tango shows.
September: warming up, highs near 18°C. Spring starts; pleasant for parks.
October: mild and green, highs near 21°C. Rain days rise; carry a small umbrella.
November: warm, highs near 25°C. Jacaranda trees bloom; great for walking.
December: hot, highs near 27°C. Festive and busy; evenings are best for sightseeing.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical climate: hot summers, cool-to-cold winters, and rain spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: March to May and September to November
items.text: Mild highs of 17–25°C. Good for walking, parks and outdoor sights.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 27–28°C with muggy nights. Sightsee early or late; rest at midday.

items.title: Winter is cool (June to August)
items.text: Highs of 14–16°C and lows near 8°C. Pack a warm coat and layers.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 6–9 rain days each month. Showers can be heavy but short; carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Windy days
items.text: Breezy spells, especially near the river in Puerto Madero. A light windproof layer helps.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, comfortable walking shoes, a light rain jacket and sunscreen for summer.

transit.best: Subte for main sights; ride apps or taxis at night.

modes.text: The Subte is small but reaches most sights. Pay with a SUBE card or contactless credit card.
Buses are cheap and cover the whole city, but routes are confusing. Use a route app.
Uber and Cabify work; taxis are plentiful and metered. Handy at night.
Driving is stressful and parking is hard. Use transit or taxis instead.
Best in Palermo, Recoleta and San Telmo. Ferries to Uruguay leave from Puerto Madero.
Ferries to Uruguay leave from Puerto Madero. Bring your passport and check times on the day.
